poolNote: On 8 July 2026 Cache replaced Overpass. Premier pick-ban uses these seven maps. Overpass, Train, and Vertigo stay playable in Competitive, Deathmatch, and community servers.

maps.name: Mirage
maps.blurb: Mid control and window. The map Premier votes pile onto.

maps.name: Inferno
maps.blurb: Banana and apartments. Utility matters more than a dry aim duel.

maps.name: Dust II
maps.blurb: Long, cat, mid doors. The other map the veto refuses to drop.

maps.name: Anubis
maps.blurb: Water, mid, and camera. A real default when the lobby will leave Mirage.

maps.name: Ancient
maps.blurb: Donut and cave. Timing and a smoke beat a dry swing.

maps.name: Nuke
maps.blurb: Outside and hut. Vertical, loud, and unforgiving without a plan.

maps.name: Cache
maps.blurb: Back in the pool since July 2026. Mid and garage are the round.

reserve.name: Overpass
reserve.blurb: Left the Premier pool when Cache came in. Still the map a lot of people want back.

reserve.name: Train
reserve.blurb: The other name that shows up every time someone asks for a map to return.

reserve.name: Vertigo
reserve.blurb: Still in the client. Ramp and stairs, if the lobby will queue it.

wants.title: A veto that is not two maps
wants.detail: Premier votes collapse onto Dust II and Mirage. The complaint, all year, is that the rest of the pool never gets played. People ask for Train and Overpass, and for a veto that cannot ban everything else.

wants.title: A crosshair you can actually finish
wants.detail: Outline transparency still moves with the crosshair, and gap still jumps in coarse steps. Players want those split apart so a clip crosshair can be copied instead of approximated.

wants.title: One useful throw, not a spreadsheet
wants.detail: The thing that wins a round is the smoke that closes the angle you keep dying to. Learn that one before a forty-lineup pack.

wants.title: Somewhere to put the code from a clip
wants.detail: Highlight pages are where crosshairs spread. The four-hour bench keeps one code on stage. A code you saw in a clip can be pasted in and voted on by the room.

utility.why: Closes CT window so a mid or cat take is not shot from above.
Stops the CT who plays car from shooting you out of T ramp.
Lets you cross mid without the CT angle from Xbox.
Breaks the default mid fight so the side you actually want can move.
Takes the donut player out of the cave or temple fight.
Closes the yard so a secret or main take is not shot from heaven.
The garage and highway cross. Cache rounds still start here.

queues.name: Premier
queues.why: The ranked veto. Season rating, and the seven-map pool.

queues.name: FACEIT
queues.why: The ladder people switch to when they want a stricter client and a set map pool.

queues.name: Competitive
queues.why: Reserve maps still live here. Overpass and Train are this queue, not Premier.

queues.name: Deathmatch
queues.why: Aim volume before a real game. Where a new crosshair gets a fair test.

queues.name: Retake
queues.why: Community servers. Post-plant and site holds, which matchmaking does not drill.

queues.name: Wingman
queues.why: Two versus two when the five-stack is not online.

clips.name: what you see is what you get

polls.question: Where should the next queue go?
